title: UPSSSC Guard / Fire Guard Recruitment 2026 Online Form Live: 170 Posts (Vidhan Bhawan Rakshak & Agnik) #UPSSSCGuard2026 #UPSSSCFireGuard #UPSSSC170Posts #UPSSSCAdvt092026 #SarkariNaukri
intro: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the Post of Guard (Vidhan Bhawan Rakshak) & Fire Guard (Vidhan Bhawan Agnik/ Agnirakshak) in Secretariat Administration Dept.(Advt.No. 09-Exam/2026) Recruitment 2026 for 170 Post for Mains Exam. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to UPSSSC Guard/ Fire Guard Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 9, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 29, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2) from any recognized board.
Must possess computer knowledge (O Level / equivalent qualification preferred).
Other Eligibility: Candidates must fulfill conditions as per UP Secretariat Security & Fire Service Rules, 2000 (Amended up to 2023).
Preference will be given to candidates who have: Minimum 2 years service in Territorial Army OR NCC ‘B’ Certificate
For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
For Age Relaxation, Read the Notification.
Height (Male):  UR/ OBC/ EWS/ SC :- 168 CMS   ||  ST:- 160 CMS
Height (Female):  UR/ OBC/ EWS/ SC :-152 CMS  ||  ST:- 147 CMS
Chest (Male Only) : UR/ OBC/ EWS/ SC :-79-84  ||  ST:- 77-82 CMS
Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of UP PET 2025 Shortlisting, Mains Written Exam, PMT/ PST & Document Verification (DV).
29 June 2026: Last date for registration & fee.
To Be Notified: Exam date, admit card, result.
